messages:
jamal: Hey team — quick Q: my family observes Eid the week of Aug 21 and that's not a company-observed day for our office. Can I swap one of my floating holidays or a company day for this instead? Do I need to get anything from my manager first?

mira: @jamal yes, you can request a religious holiday substitution. We have a short process — fill the Holiday Substitution form in the HR portal and ping your manager. :pray:

people-ops: Quick checklist: 1) Submit the form at least 10 business days before the date; 2) Manager approval required; 3) People Ops will confirm payroll/carryover implications. If you don't have any floating days left, options are PTO or unpaid.

people-ops: Policy excerpt for reference: "Employees may substitute up to two company-observed holidays per calendar year for bona fide religious observances with prior notice and manager approval. Substitutions do not increase the annual holiday bank; they reassign an existing observed day or a floating day."

jen: FYI managers — when you approve, please update the team calendar and on-call rotation. Suggested subject for the calendar/event: `Holiday substitution — Jamal — Eid (Aug 21)`. Also add a short note in the event description with approval: `approved by manager on <date>`.

jamal: Thanks, filling the form now. @jen can you help patch the calendar once it's approved? I'll drop the form link here when done.

hr-bot: Submitted: Holiday Substitution form received for Jamal on 2026-08-05. Ticket #HR-4321 created and assigned to Jen and Mira. Expected action within 48h. :white_check_mark:

mira: @jamal once approved, the system will auto-deduct the floating holiday. If you'd rather use a company-observed day and request an exec exception (rare), we can start that conversation but it takes longer. Let us know which you prefer.
